name: Algernon
source:
Algernon belongs to one of the four noble vampire families in the makai, specifically, to the one who controls the element of wind. He's Joshua's childhood friend and doesn't like the idea of Yuri getting too friendly with his friend.
He's Henrietta's twin brother.
